subject.title: [Feature]: Self-evolving SOUL.md via opt-in reflection sub-turn + soul_update tool

question: Should OpenClaw core add an opt-in runtime path that lets a reflection sub-turn persist durable preferences into SOUL.md?
rationale: This crosses core prompt context, new config surface, agent tool exposure, persistent instruction-file writes, and security posture, so automation cannot choose the product boundary safely.

options.title: Review linked PR as candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95793 as the implementation vehicle and resolve the product/security blockers there before closing this issue.

options.title: Move to memory or plugin seam
options.body: Reject direct SOUL.md mutation in core and ask for preference capture through memory plugins or a new plugin/API extension.

options.title: Decline automatic mutation
options.body: Close this issue and the overlapping older issue only if maintainers decide model-mediated instruction-file writes should not be offered.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95793 as the implementation vehicle and resolve the product/security blockers there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans SOUL docs, prompt assembly, config, runtime ownership, and security posture, where this handle has the strongest feature-history signal.
